title: Twelve native targets
subtitle: Current compatibility, installation and runtime evidence
historical_note: Pages 1-14 preserve the original illustrated feature guide and its Minecraft 1.21.1 Fabric captures. This appendix supersedes their installation matrix, test totals and verification-scope statements. The controls and feature descriptions remain applicable.
java_requirements: Java 17 for Minecraft 1.20.1; Java 21 for 1.21.1 and 1.21.11; Java 25 for every 26.x target.
fabric_loader_requirements: Fabric Loader 0.18.2 or newer for 1.20.1 and 1.21.1; 0.19.2 or newer for 1.21.11; 0.19.5 or newer for every 26.x target.
legacy_loom_note: Minecraft 1.20.1 retains Core's existing blank large Loom banner preview. Native pattern selection, result transfers, input consumption and replenishment work; the modern targets also render the banner preview.

modern_evidence.title: Modern rendering: radial focus
modern_evidence.caption: Character is focused in the radial workspace. The surrounding previews use the native window renderers with the companion's transformed placement and queued opacity.

modern_evidence.title: Exact transfers between windows
modern_evidence.caption: Two existing container sessions form the displayed pair. Quick-move routes to the other displayed storage window; the server checks destination authorization and item conservation.

modern_evidence.title: Native UI beyond the base rectangle
modern_evidence.caption: The test view's external button receives the configured native A action through its own interactive region. Its window identity and UI state survive tuck and restoration.

modern_evidence.title: Native results and retained inputs
modern_evidence.caption: A Loom result moves into the selected container. Native callbacks consume one banner and dye, replenish the next result, and conserve the two completed banners across the displayed destinations.
